guards: Closed status closes this selected consumer read set, not the named-map authoring recipe.
Keep terrain classification bytes, corner-record indices, DDS samples, GPU float texture coordinates and native map axes separate.
Do not derive512/513 height dimensions, a texel-centre correction or a world-to-image flip from the33-by33 corner-record grid.

conclusion: The square32 terrain-byte copy/lookup preserves native axes and feeds a33-by33 classification-neighbor corner grid. The alleged transform callback resolves to NiNode collection bookkeeping; provider continuations resolve to dynamic scene/property and indexed-manager dispatch. Converted heights are retained in a refcounted GPU/resource wrapper with an immediate consumer at global0x8314F28C virtual+0xB8. Neither that current target nor an actual height sampler/vertex producer is joined. Native texture orientation, shared height edges, filtering and sea scale remain open at these precise frontiers.
